description: Window controls (drag / minimize / maximize / close) for the in-window RePlayer, served from the bridge's own 127.0.0.1 loopback in the main window. Mirrors monitor.json's least-privilege posture: window manipulation ONLY — no file, bridge, store, dialog, or app commands — so the bridge-served player page can manage its frameless window but cannot reach anything sensitive. Enumerates the bridge's fixed canonical port set (43210-43214).
